patch:
diff --git a/main.py b/main.py
index 0000000..1111111 100644
--- a/main.py
+++ b/main.py
@@ -1,2 +1,43 @@
-def recite(start: int, take: int = 1) -> list[str]:
-    pass
+def recite(start: int, take: int = 1) -> list[str]:
+    if start < 0:
+        raise ValueError("Start must be non-negative")
+    if take < 0:
+        raise ValueError("Take must be non-negative")
+    
+    result = []
+    for i in range(start, start - take, -1):
+        if i < 0:
+            break
+            
+        # Handle the case when we have 0 bottles initially
+        if i == 0:
+            verse = [
+                "No more bottles of beer on the wall, no more bottles of beer.",
+                "Go to the store and buy some more, 99 bottles of beer on the wall."
+            ]
+        else:
+            # Determine bottle text for current number
+            current_bottles = f"{i} bottle{'s' if i != 1 else ''}"
+            
+            # Determine next number and its bottle text
+            next_num = i - 1
+            if next_num == 0:
+                next_bottles = "no more bottles"
+            else:
+                next_bottles = f"{next_num} bottle{'s' if next_num != 1 else ''}"
+            
+            # Determine action text
+            action = "Take it down and pass it around" if i == 1 else "Take one down and pass it around"
+            
+            verse = [
+                f"{current_bottles.capitalize()} of beer on the wall, {current_bottles} of beer.",
+                f"{action}, {next_bottles} of beer on the wall."
+            ]
+        
+        result.extend(verse)
+        
+        # Add empty line between verses except after the last verse
+        if i > start - take + 1 and i > 0:
+            result.append("")
+    
+    return result
